function.name: execute_bash

message.reasoning_content:
**Setting up server testing**

I'm looking to set up a test server and it seems that some unused crypto could work for this. There's an important bug to address related to saving conflicts, particularly in how differences in the base and workbook handle remote changes. It looks like stale payloads will leave untouched remote cells. In order to maintain integrity, strict validation should compare the current title. Alright, I will start this process in the background!
